columns.bom.customers.region: Where the customer is based: North America or Europe.
columns.bom.products.sku: Short product code used in questions: KR-6 (robot arm), SK-9 (drone), PU-3 (pump).
columns.bom.products.annual_volume: Units of this product built per year. Multiply a per-unit saving or cost by it for a yearly figure.
columns.bom.products.target_unit_cost: The cost the customer wants one finished unit to come in under, in USD.
columns.bom.products.required_certification: The quality certification a manufacturer of this product's custom parts must hold (AS9100 or ISO 9001).
columns.bom.products.region_restriction: When 'North America', every part of the product must come from a facility in North America. NULL means no restriction.
columns.bom.bom_lines.quantity: How many of this part go into ONE unit of the assembly (so a part used in several assemblies must be summed).
columns.bom.parts.source_type: custom = made to our drawing; catalog = bought from a catalog; standard = off-the-shelf.
columns.bom.parts.is_critical: True when engineering must review any change to the part; a critical part is never swapped automatically.
columns.bom.parts.tolerance_mm: Tightest dimensional tolerance the part needs, in millimetres. A SMALLER number is a TIGHTER tolerance.
columns.bom.parts.catalog_item_id: Only set for the few parts that are bought as a catalog item; NULL for custom parts. Not a replacement link: whether a catalog item could replace a custom part is decided by matching shape, material, finish, tolerance and size, never through this column.
columns.bom.catalog_items.min_tolerance_mm: Tightest tolerance the catalog item can hold, in millimetres (smaller = tighter). It can replace a part only if min_tolerance_mm <= the part's tolerance_mm.
columns.bom.catalog_items.max_length_mm: Largest length the catalog item is offered in, in millimetres.
columns.bom.catalog_items.max_width_mm: Largest width the catalog item is offered in, in millimetres.
columns.bom.catalog_items.max_height_mm: Largest height the catalog item is offered in, in millimetres.
columns.bom.catalog_items.unit_price: Catalog price for one unit in USD. It carries no separate duty, so compare it with the part's landed cost.
columns.bom.catalog_items.distributor_certificat: Certification of the distributor selling the item: AS9120 (aerospace distributors) or ISO 9001.
columns.bom.materials.cost_per_kg: Raw material price per kilogram, in USD.
columns.bom.facilities.region: North America, Europe or Asia Pacific.
columns.bom.facilities.utilization_pct: Percent of capacity in use (40 to 97). 95 or more means the facility cannot take new work.
columns.bom.facilities.status: Operating state of the facility (all are Active); availability is judged from utilization_pct and supply_events, not from this column.
columns.bom.certifications.applies_to: Manufacturers or Distributors: which kind of facility can hold it.
columns.bom.facility_certifications.expires_on: Last day the certificate is valid. It is valid only while expires_on >= CURRENT_DATE; an expired row means the facility does not hold the certificate.
columns.bom.machines.tightest_tolerance_mm: Tightest tolerance the machine can hold, in millimetres (smaller = tighter).
columns.bom.quotes.unit_cost: Supplier price for one unit before import duty, in USD.
columns.bom.quotes.tariff_pct: Import duty on this quote as a percentage (0 to 25). Landed cost = unit_cost * (1 + tariff_pct / 100).
columns.bom.quotes.is_current_source: True for the single quote each part is bought on today; every part has exactly one current-source quote. The other quotes are alternative sources.
columns.bom.quotes.valid_until: Date the quote expires; all current quotes run to the same date.
columns.bom.approved_vendors.status: approved, pending or blocked. A supplier is approved for a customer ONLY when its row for that customer says 'approved'; a missing row or any other status means not approved.
columns.bom.approved_vendors.customer_id: The customer whose approved-vendor list this row belongs to (a supplier approved by one customer is not necessarily approved by another).
columns.bom.work_orders.scrap_quantity: Units scrapped in the run. Scrap rate = scrap_quantity / quantity.
columns.bom.work_orders.actual_end: Date the run actually finished; NULL while In progress.
columns.bom.nonconformances.cost: Cost of the defect in USD.
columns.bom.nonconformances.disposition: What was done with the defective parts: Rework, Scrap, Use as is or Return to supplier.
columns.bom.engineering_changes.status: Open, In review or Approved. Open and In review are still in progress.
columns.bom.supply_events.event_type: Fire, Typhoon, Capacity constraint, Certificate lapse or Tariff change.
columns.bom.supply_events.status: Active (still affecting the facility) or Resolved.
columns.bom.purchase_orders.received_date: Date it actually arrived; NULL if not yet received. Late means received_date > promised_date.
columns.bom.purchase_orders.unit_cost: Price paid per unit in USD, before duty. Historical: it can differ from the part's current quote.
columns.bom.inventory.on_hand: Units in stock at the facility.
columns.bom.inventory.safety_stock: Minimum units to keep; below safety stock when on_hand < safety_stock.
columns.bom.dfm_findings.saving_pct: Percent of the part's cost this suggestion would save (5 to 22). For a dollar figure apply it to the part's landed cost on its current-source quote times the quantity used.
columns.bom.dfm_findings.performance_impact: None means no effect on performance (safe); 'Needs engineering validation' means it must be checked before it can count as a no-risk saving.

definitions.bom.quotes: DEFINITION compliant source for a product: a quote whose facility (1) is in the product's region when region_restriction is set, (2) holds an unexpired certificate matching the product's required_certification (AS9100 for a custom part made by a manufacturer; an AS9120 distributor for catalog or standard parts), (3) has utilization_pct below 95, (4) has no Active High-severity supply event, and (5) belongs to a supplier whose approved_vendors status for the product's customer is 'approved'.
definitions.bom.parts: DEFINITION a custom part can be replaced by a catalog item when it is not critical and some catalog item has the same material, shape and finish, a min_tolerance_mm no tighter than the part's tolerance_mm, maximum length, width and height at least the part's, a unit_price below the part's landed cost on its current-source quote, and a distributor certification of AS9120 when the product requires AS9100. Yearly saving = (landed cost - catalog price) * quantity used per unit * the product's annual_volume.
definitions.bom.dfm_findings: DEFINITION saving per unit of a finding = quantity of the part per unit * landed cost on the part's current-source quote * saving_pct / 100; only findings with performance_impact 'None' count as no-risk.
